extension_enabled.description: Enable the PL/Lua procedural language extension in PostgreSQL. When enabled, users can create functions in Lua.

lua_safe_mode.description: Run Lua code in PostgreSQL in safe mode (restricted environment, no direct OS access). Disable only in trusted environments.

lua_module_search_paths.description: Additional directories to search for Lua modules (e.g., '?.lua') when loading external Lua files via `require()`.

items.description: A filesystem path (absolute or relative) to a directory containing Lua modules.
